description: Story mission/demo catalogue and launch hub: presentation, pre/post battle scripts, mission and room links, relation changes, unlocks and rewards for each story demo.

ID.technical: FName row key in StoryDemoDataTables (DTM +0x8C0). Used as the save-state key in StudioStoryDemoStates_5E0 / StudioStoryDemoSeen_630, as the launch request's Name2C, for chapter membership checks and throughout the relation UI. Main demos are identified by an Id ending in "M" (case-insensitive) in the progress helpers.

MissionIndex.simple: Display number of the mission within its chapter.
MissionIndex.technical: int32 (row +0x10), default 0 in the constructor. GameScript_ShowTitle passes it to UGameStoryDemoWidget::SetupTitle, which inserts it as a two-digit zero-padded integer text parameter; exported values are 0..114 and unique across the table.

Id_StoryMissionTitle.simple: Localized-text id for the mission/demo title.
Id_StoryMissionTitle.technical: FName (row +0x14). Used by mission-select content/detail, character-select mission info, relation mission list items, system dialogs, shop sale descriptions, collection archive movie items and the script ShowTitle command.

Id_StoryMissionDetail.simple: Localized-text id for the mission explanation.
Id_StoryMissionDetail.technical: FName (row +0x1C). GameStoryMissionSelectWidget sets it on the detail explanation text; exported values use the pattern <demo id>_EXPLANATION.

ThumbnailFileName.technical: FName. GameScript_ShowTitle dynamically loads it for the title image; UGameScriptPlayer also adds it to WidgetTexture loader names when the running script is this demo's pre- or post-battle script.

SmallThumbnailFileName.technical: FName (row +0x2C). Used as the WidgetTexture loader key for mission-select content entries and installed as the ReplacementTexture material parameter on open.

Id_Script_PreBattle.simple: Script to play before the story battle.
Id_Script_PreBattle.technical: FName (row +0x34). Story_GetPreBattleScriptId returns it (retail dereferences the row unchecked); Story_ResolveDemoLaunch uses non-None to route to StoryDemoPreBattle and resolves that script's levels, while a None value with a mission routes directly to BattleStory. Script commands and the script player also match running script names against this field for DLC checks and thumbnail preload.

Id_Script_PostBattle.simple: Script to play after the story battle.
Id_Script_PostBattle.technical: FName (row +0x3C). Story_GetPostBattleScriptId returns it; after a won story battle, BattleStory requests StoryDemoPostBattle with the script's levels when non-None. Also used in DLC-script detection and script thumbnail preload.

Id_StoryMission.simple: StoryMission row to run for this demo.
Id_StoryMission.technical: FName (row +0x44). Story_ResolveDemoLaunch copies it into FStudioPhaseRequest.Name34 and uses it to fetch the mission/first wave/playable character and battle level; the result screen reads the saved rank for this id. None means no battle mission: the launch uses the room placement instead or the pre-battle script path. The demo row's mission also drives objective/mission-task lookup through Story_GetDemoMissionTask_13096F0.

Id_StoryRoomCondition.simple: Room-condition row used to pick this demo's story room layout.
Id_StoryRoomCondition.technical: FName (row +0x4C). Story_PickRoomPlacement_13097C0 collects non-None values from all cleared demos when the checkpoint chapter is still pending, or from all demos when everything is cleared (default ROOM_COND_0000), then resolves the condition row for a weighted placement pick. None entries are ignored by those scans.

Id_StoryCharaRelateChange.simple: Relation-change rows applied on first clear of this demo.
Id_StoryCharaRelateChange.technical: TArray<FName> with 12 exported slots. OnStoryDemoFirstClear skips None, finds each StoryCharaRelateChange row and adds its directed deltas to the save data; the relation UI filters those rows by character pair to list the demo, and the result dialog aggregates them. Non-None entries also count toward story completion percentage.

Id_StoryDemo.simple: Unlocked child demos / open conditions for this mission.
Id_StoryDemo.technical: TArray<FName> with two exported slots. Mission-select content shows one open-condition text per valid non-None entry (as a MISSION text parameter); MainMenuStory filters demos by whether any child demo is available and uses the list as prerequisite state for unlocking. Never null-checked as an array in those consumers beyond IsValidIndex where present.

Id_Character_Release.simple: Characters unlocked by clearing this demo.
Id_Character_Release.technical: TArray<FName> with three exported slots. On first clear a non-None entry marks the demo in StudioMissionInts_6D0; MainMenuStory turns values 1 -> 2 (newly released) and collects the ids for the character-select/release notifications. Story_HasNewCharaRelate uses the same map plus this list to determine which characters are released before checking pair news.

Id_Character_Pair_Release_1.simple: First halves of character pairs unlocked by this demo.
Id_Character_Pair_Release_1.technical: TArray<FName> (nine exported slots), parallel to Id_Character_Pair_Release_2. A non-None first entry marks the demo in StudioNameInts_720; MainMenuStory builds unordered released-pair sets and the relation UI uses the same pairs to decide which character relationships are visible. Index-wise loops break when the parallel array runs out and skip None entries.

Id_Character_Pair_Release_2.simple: Second halves of character pairs unlocked by this demo.
Id_Character_Pair_Release_2.technical: TArray<FName> parallel to Id_Character_Pair_Release_1; each valid pair (First, Second) is added to the released-pair collections. Pair-release lists are counted in the story completion percentage and gate relation-news checks.

Id_ItemSet.simple: Reward item sets for this demo.
Id_ItemSet.technical: TArray<FName> (three exported slots). Index 0 is the clear reward, indices n>0 correspond to mission tasks n-1: Story_GetDemoRewardItem_130A230 verifies the task detail text exists for n>0, resolves Id_ItemSet[index] in ItemSetDataTables and returns the first item and quantity. MainMenuStory grants index 0 on clear and index n+1 when task flag n is completed, using GameShop_AddItemSetOnce(..., 2).

notes: The pre/post script fields also serve as reverse keys: GameScript_IsDlcScript and UGameScriptPlayer find the demo row by matching a running script name against either field.

Many consumers deliberately dereference the found row without a null check (e.g. Story_GetPreBattleScriptId and the room-condition scans); missing ids can fault in reconstructed retail-shaped code rather than degrade gracefully.
115 exported rows; MissionIndex is unique in the export. No numbered shards or localization variants of this table were exported. No exhaustive Blueprint-use claim is made.

usages.detail: Story_ResolveDemoLaunch chooses phase 15/16/23, battle level, playable character and levels from the demo row and its linked mission/script.
Story_PickRoomPlacement derives the room condition from demo progress and linked demos.
Applies character and pair releases plus relation changes on first clear.
Computes releases, seen states, rewards and available demos from all demo rows.
Builds the relation detail's mission list from demos referencing the selected pair's relation changes.
Shows the script title using demo title text, mission index and thumbnail.
